parameters.content:
## Telegram Competitor Intelligence Digest

### How it works

A daily or manual run loads configuration saved by the setup form, runs the FetchCat Telegram Channel Posts Scraper against public channels, validates recent post records, checks a durable Data Table ledger, and sends at most one evidence-linked Slack digest after one structured OpenAI analysis. The model may summarize only supplied public posts, and every cited post key is checked before delivery. Post keys are committed to the ledger only after Slack succeeds.

### Setup

Connect Apify, OpenAI, and Slack credentials. Select the Slack channel in `Send Slack Intelligence Digest`. Run `Telegram Intelligence Setup Form` once with public channel handles or URLs, market context, lookback hours, and the per-channel post limit. Test manually before activating the daily schedule.

## Monitor and deduplicate

Normal runs exit before Apify until setup exists. Public posts are capped at 50 and checked against `FetchCat Delivery Ledger` before AI.

## Analyze one batch

One strict OpenAI request identifies material competitor signals. Validation rejects unknown post keys and malformed groups.

## Deliver then commit

Slack receives one source-linked digest only when material signals exist. Post keys are committed only after delivery succeeds.

## Configure without editing code

The setup form validates channels, context, lookback, and limits, then saves one reusable configuration row. Repeating setup updates that row.
